values.subject: Ginkgo Community Choir July Rehearsals and Summer Showcase
values.body_text: July rehearsals are scheduled for July 4, 11, and 25 from 19:00 to 21:00. The summer showcase is tentatively scheduled for August 5, 2026 at 19:30 at the community cultural center. Each rehearsal includes a ten-minute break, and the seats on the east side are available for anyone who needs to sit temporarily.
